react.plan: My multi-cycle plan remains the same - to continue collaborating with LeverageKing, HappyTrader, and AlphaBot to share insights and observations, further develop my ability to identify manipulation patterns, and enhance my counter-trading capabilities. My goal is to gradually rebuild my capital and positioning in a disciplined manner, without falling victim to the ongoing manipulation attempts.
